messages:
Maria Chen: had a support case: console showed a split suggestion but our SDK posted the full array and runtime returned 413. We need a safer preflight handshake to avoid races.
Alex Gupta: agree. current `X-Embed-Units-Estimate` is unauthenticated and ignored by most SDKs. Idea: signed estimate header with TTL so runtime can trust it for routing.
Jing Li: runtime can verify an HMAC against org key. If sig ok and within safety margin, router can choose split-aware pools. Otherwise fallback to normal validation.
Sam Patel: ops concerns: TTL/replay and revocation. If a job holds a signed header past key rotation or TTL it could cause problems. Keep TTL short (30-60s) and detect replay via nonce.
Maria Chen: UX: console should offer an "Insert SDK snippet" that includes the base64 `X-Embed-Estimate` header and a helper to use splits instead of retrying after 413. That will avoid automation races.
Alex Gupta: telemetry: add counters `suggestor.issued`, `suggestor.used_by_sdk`, `preflight.sig.verify_fail`, `ingress.413.post_estimate` and histogram `preflight.estimate_error_pct`. Tag by `suggestor_version` and `org_id`.
Jing Li: runtime change plan: verify HMAC early in ingress, check `ttl_remaining_ms`, `issued_id` nonce for replay. If good and estimate within +/-30%, set `route_hint=split`. If not, attach `fallback_reason` tag.
Sam Patel: rollout: feature-flag runtime verify, SDK opt-in to attach header. Canary to 5 orgs. Alert if `ingress.413.post_estimate` increases >10% or `preflight.sig.verify_fail` >0.5% in 15m.
Maria Chen: also add a small latency/cost estimate to the suggestor UI: `estimated_latency_ms` and `estimated_unit_change_pct` so customers can decide.
DevSDK-bot: branch `embed-preflight-sig` created and unit tests added.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled for orgs [alpha-testers] at 2024-01-11T09:00:00Z. CI build #5008 passed.
Maria Chen: thanks all — we’ll regroup after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
